summary: Images and videos of your media library.
features: Images and videos of your media library.
requirements: A Cloudinary account with permission to use its MCP server
Node.js and npm to run the server
limits: Available tools and access depend on the upstream server and account permissions
Live account access has not been verified for this extension package
pricing: Your service plan, API access requirements and usage quotas apply; no subscription is included.
privacy: Requests and authorized account data are exchanged with the configured service. Server output may enter agent context as untrusted content.
tagline: Review images and videos in your media library
description:
Connect Cloudinary to work with the images and videos available in your media library. Select an asset and bring its available information into APX to understand which media belongs in a project or to compare candidate assets.

Keep the selected asset identifiable rather than relying only on a similar filename. Cloudinary's asset-management tools and your account permissions determine what can be read or changed. The connection does not include storage, delivery credits or a license to reuse media; check the chosen asset's rights before publishing it.
prompts: Review the available information for the Cloudinary image I select.
Compare the two selected media assets for the project brief I provide.
Summarize the available details of the video I choose without changing the library.

es.tagline: Revisá imágenes y videos de tu biblioteca
es.description:
Conectá Cloudinary para trabajar con las imágenes y los videos disponibles en tu biblioteca. Elegí un recurso y traé su información a APX para entender qué material sirve para un proyecto o comparar opciones.

Mantené identificado el recurso elegido, sin depender sólo de un nombre de archivo parecido. Las herramientas de administración de Cloudinary y los permisos de tu cuenta determinan qué se puede leer o cambiar. La conexión no incluye almacenamiento, créditos de entrega ni derechos de reutilización: revisá la licencia del recurso antes de publicarlo.
prompts: Revisá la información disponible de la imagen de Cloudinary que elija.
Compará los dos recursos elegidos para el proyecto que te describa.
Resumí los detalles disponibles del video que seleccione sin modificar la biblioteca.
